Definition: a Punite (collectively), the descendants of Puvah
BiblicalUsage: Puni is a Punite, a descendant of Puvah, collectively the family of the Punites. It appears once, in the census of Issachar: of Puvah, the family of the Punites.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God counts families the way He counts men: the Punites are named in the census because the son of Issachar was not forgotten.
